answer: Gate entry through a narrow inlet: every new identity pays a small refundable deposit and joins a rate-limited onboarding queue, then earns full trading rights only after completing a voyage of verifiable, useful deliveries attested by independent peers. An attacker may wander through dozens of fake accounts, but each one must pay the deposit and actually do the work, so costs multiply per identity while per-account rewards stay capped. Mass fabrication then loses money instead of printing it.
